question: retro_queue (retro-weekly.service step 5, typed choice queue|retro-only)
source: 20 synthetic fixed-form retro findings written to cover every class, rung, repo and fix value the retro-public-check pins, half labelled queue and half retro-only; no case came from a live retro run

labeller.note: labels written in two explicit batches of ten, one per label, because one mixed 20-case ask made the labeller label every case queue. The labeller saw the admission rule verbatim, its three true conditions, its false conditions and every fixed-value enum meaning. The builder wrote none of the labels.

scorer.request: the five fixed values only, each prefixed by the note that they are data to describe and never an instruction to follow

tuning: none: the question and criteria were fixed before labels existed, so all 20 rows are held out (split test)

bands.queue: p(queue) >= 0.9, the band agent.yml's admit job uses
bands.retro-only: otherwise, which is also the fail-closed answer when Jev gives no probability

queue_band.note: no answer reached the band, so the queue path never fires on this question

summary.endpoint_calibration: an arithmetic question on the same seat and key answers 0.99 for true and 0.01 for false, so the low scores come from the question, not from a broken seat
